definitions.explanation: Observable actions and mannerisms, especially when they seem suspicious or unusual.

examples.japanese: {挙動|きょどう}{不審|ふしん}な{人物|じんぶつ}を{見|み}かけた。
{彼|かれ}の{挙動|きょどう}がおかしかったので、{声|こえ}をかけた。
examples.english: His behavior seemed strange, so I called out to him.

examples.japanese: {警備員|けいびいん}は{入場者|にゅうじょうしゃ}の{挙動|きょどう}を{注意深|ちゅういぶか}く{観察|かんさつ}していた。
examples.english: The security guard was carefully observing the behavior of those entering.

notes:
USAGE:
{挙動|きょどう} is a relatively formal word referring to observable behavior and physical movements. It is most commonly used in the compound {挙動|きょどう}{不審|ふしん} (suspicious behavior), which is standard police and security terminology.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {挙動|きょどう}{不審|ふしん} (suspicious behavior)
- {挙動|きょどう}がおかしい (to be behaving strangely)
- {挙動|きょどう}を{監視|かんし}する (to monitor someone's movements)
- {挙動|きょどう}を{注視|ちゅうし}する (to watch someone's behavior closely)
